note: Steps are a simple guide as of 2026-10-29. No income is promised; rules and fees change, so always check the official site.

items.title: Getting started: wallets, email and portfolio
steps: Use a separate email only for work and gigs; turn on 2-step verification.
Set up a verified e-wallet (GCash or Maya) with your own valid ID. Never lend your account to others.
Open a PayPal account in your own name and link a PH bank or e-wallet for withdrawals, if the platform pays via PayPal.
Make a simple portfolio: 3 to 5 samples of your work (Google Drive, Canva or a free site).
Write a one-paragraph profile: skills, tools, availability and time zone.
steps_tl: Gumamit ng hiwalay na email para sa trabaho at gig lang. I-on ang 2-step verification.
Mag-set up ng verified na e-wallet (GCash o Maya) gamit ang sarili mong valid ID. Huwag ipahiram ang account.
Magbukas ng PayPal account sa pangalan mo at i-link ang PH bank o e-wallet para sa withdrawal, kung sa PayPal nagbabayad ang platform.
Gumawa ng simpleng portfolio: 3 hanggang 5 sample ng gawa mo (Google Drive, Canva, o libreng site).
Sumulat ng isang talatang profile: skills, tools, availability, at time zone.
items.tip: Never share OTPs, passwords or MPINs with anyone, including 'recruiters'.
items.tip_tl: Huwag ibahagi ang OTP, password, o MPIN kaninuman, kasama ang recruiter.

items.title: Avoid scams: red flags and where to report
items.title_tl: Iwas-scam: mga red flag at saan mag-ulat
steps: Red flag: you must pay a fee, 'starter kit' or deposit to get work. Legit platforms don't charge to apply.
Red flag: you earn mainly by recruiting people, or 'guaranteed' daily income. That is a pyramid or investment scam.
Red flag: they ask you to move chat and payment off the platform, or to 'like and follow' for pay then 'top up' to withdraw.
Check the SEC advisories list before joining any 'earn' or 'investment' group.
Report online scams to CICC (hotline 1326), investment scams to SEC, and seller/consumer issues to DTI.
steps_tl: Red flag: kailangan mong magbayad ng fee, starter kit, o deposito para makakuha ng trabaho. Hindi naniningil ang lehitimong platform para mag-apply.
Red flag: kumikita ka pangunahin sa pag-recruit ng tao, o may garantisadong araw-araw na kita. Pyramid o investment scam iyon.
Red flag: inililipat ka nila ng chat at bayad palabas ng platform, o pinapalike at pina-follow para sa bayad tapos pinapa-top up para makapag-withdraw.
Tingnan ang listahan ng SEC advisories bago sumali sa anumang earn o investment group.
I-report ang online scam sa CICC (hotline 1326), ang investment scam sa SEC, at ang usapin ng seller o consumer sa DTI.
items.tip: If it sounds too easy, it probably is.
items.tip_tl: Kung masyadong madali, malamang hindi totoo.

items.title: Surveys and micro-tasks
steps: Check that the platform accepts the Philippines before signing up; many survey sites do not.
Sign up with your real details; fake details get accounts banned and payouts cancelled.
Read the payout method and minimum before working (PayPal, bank or app credit).
Expect small, irregular amounts; treat it as pocket money, not a salary.
Track time spent vs. earned to decide if it's worth it.
steps_tl: Tingnan kung tinatanggap ng platform ang Pilipinas bago mag-sign up. Maraming survey site ang hindi.
Mag-sign up gamit ang totoong detalye. Na-ba-ban ang pekeng detalye at kinakansela ang payout.
Basahin ang paraan ng payout at ang minimum bago magtrabaho (PayPal, banko, o app credit).
Asahan ang maliit at hindi regular na halaga. Ituring itong pang-gastos, hindi suweldo.
I-track ang oras na ginugol kumpara sa kinita para malaman kung sulit.
items.tip: Google Opinion Rewards pays Google Play credit, not cash.
items.tip_tl: Google Play credit ang binabayad ng Google Opinion Rewards, hindi cash.

items.title: Freelancing basics: profile, proposal, first client
items.title_tl: Mga batayan ng freelancing: profile, proposal, unang kliyente
steps: Pick one skill to start (virtual assistance, writing, design, data entry, social media).
Take free training (DICT, TESDA Online) to build skills.
Create a complete profile on one or two platforms; add your portfolio.
Send short, specific proposals that answer the client's post; don't copy-paste.
Keep all contracts and payments on-platform until you trust the client.
steps_tl: Pumili ng isang skill na sisimulan (virtual assistance, pagsusulat, disenyo, data entry, social media).
Kumuha ng libreng training (DICT, TESDA Online) para palakasin ang skill.
Gumawa ng kumpletong profile sa isa o dalawang platform. Idagdag ang portfolio.
Magpadala ng maikli at tiyak na proposal na sumasagot sa post ng kliyente. Huwag mag-copy-paste.
Panatilihin ang kontrata at bayad sa loob ng platform hanggang magtiwala ka sa kliyente.
items.tip: Read each platform's fees and payout rules before accepting work.
items.tip_tl: Basahin ang fee at payout rules ng bawat platform bago tumanggap ng trabaho.

items.title: Selling online and reselling
steps: Choose what to sell: preloved items, reselling, or your own products.
Open a seller account on one marketplace and read its fees and policies.
Take clear photos, write honest descriptions and set prices that cover fees and shipping.
Use the platform's checkout; avoid advance payments outside it.
Register your business (DTI) and with BIR once you sell regularly.
steps_tl: Piliin kung ano ang ibebenta: preloved, reselling, o sarili mong produkto.
Magbukas ng seller account sa isang marketplace at basahin ang fee at patakaran nito.
Kumuha ng malinaw na litrato, sumulat ng tapat na paglalarawan, at magtakda ng presyong kasya ang fee at shipping.
Gamitin ang checkout ng platform. Iwasan ang advance na bayad sa labas nito.
Irehistro ang negosyo (DTI) at sa BIR kapag regular ka nang nagbebenta.
items.tip: Check that items you resell are not counterfeit or prohibited.
items.tip_tl: Tiyakin na hindi peke o bawal ang inire-resell mo.

items.title: Affiliate marketing
steps: Join an official affiliate program and read its rules.
Share product links only for items you'd honestly recommend.
Disclose that you earn a commission from links.
Commissions are paid only on completed orders, per program terms.
steps_tl: Sumali sa opisyal na affiliate program at basahin ang patakaran nito.
Magbahagi ng product link lang para sa bagay na tapat mong irerekomenda.
Sabihin na kumikita ka ng komisyon mula sa link.
Binabayaran ang komisyon sa natapos na order lang, ayon sa tuntunin ng program.
items.tip: Never buy your own links or spam groups; accounts get banned.
items.tip_tl: Huwag bilhin ang sarili mong link o mag-spam sa mga grupo. Na-ba-ban ang account.

items.title: Content creation and monetization
steps: Pick a topic you can post about regularly.
Read each platform's official monetization eligibility (followers, watch time, region) on its own page.
Use only music and clips you have rights to.
Monetization requirements change; recheck the official pages.
steps_tl: Pumili ng paksang mailalathala mo nang regular.
Basahin ang opisyal na eligibility ng monetization ng bawat platform (followers, watch time, rehiyon) sa sarili nitong pahina.
Gamitin lang ang musika at clip na may karapatan ka.
Nagbabago ang requirements ng monetization. Balikan ang opisyal na pahina.
items.tip: Civi does not quote follower or income thresholds; read them on the official page.
items.tip_tl: Hindi sinisipi ng Civi ang follower o income threshold. Basahin ito sa opisyal na pahina.

items.title: Digital products
steps: Make something reusable: templates, e-books, presets, printables.
Choose a platform and read its fees and payout options.
Write a clear description and preview.
Only sell content you created or have rights to.
steps_tl: Gumawa ng bagay na magagamit ulit: template, e-book, preset, printable.
Pumili ng platform at basahin ang fee at payout nito.
Sumulat ng malinaw na paglalarawan at preview.
Ibenta lang ang content na ikaw ang gumawa o may karapatan ka.

items.title: Teaching online
steps: Check each platform's requirements (language, degree, certificates, equipment).
Prepare a quiet space, headset and stable internet.
Make a short intro video if the platform asks.
Set your schedule and read the cancellation and payout rules.
steps_tl: Tingnan ang requirements ng bawat platform (wika, degree, sertipiko, kagamitan).
Maghanda ng tahimik na lugar, headset, at matatag na internet.
Gumawa ng maikling intro video kung hinihingi ng platform.
Itakda ang iskedyul at basahin ang patakaran sa cancellation at payout.

items.title: Print-on-demand and stock photos
steps: Upload only original work you own.
Get signed releases for recognizable people or private property.
Follow each site's technical and content guidelines.
Earnings depend on sales; there is no fixed pay.
steps_tl: Mag-upload lang ng orihinal na gawa na pag-aari mo.
Kumuha ng pirmadong release para sa makikilalang tao o pribadong ari-arian.
Sundin ang technical at content guidelines ng bawat site.
Nakabatay sa benta ang kita. Walang nakapirming bayad.

items.title: Rider and delivery gigs
steps: Apply only through the official app or website.
Prepare the license, registration and documents the platform lists.
Never pay 'agents' to get approved.
Know your coverage: check SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG as a self-employed member.
steps_tl: Mag-apply sa opisyal na app o website lang.
Ihanda ang lisensya, rehistrasyon, at dokumentong nakalista sa platform.
Huwag magbayad ng ahente para maaprubahan.
Alamin ang coverage mo: tingnan ang SSS, PhilHealth, at Pag-IBIG bilang self-employed na miyembro.

items.title: Home-based food business
steps: Check with your barangay and city hall for permits.
Get a sanitary permit and health certificates for food handlers.
Check FDA rules: some packaged foods need a License to Operate and product registration.
Register your business name with DTI and register with BIR.
steps_tl: Magtanong sa barangay at city hall tungkol sa permit.
Kumuha ng sanitary permit at health certificate para sa food handler.
Tingnan ang patakaran ng FDA: ang ilang nakabalot na pagkain ay kailangan ng License to Operate at product registration.
Irehistro ang business name sa DTI at magparehistro sa BIR.
items.tip_tl: Tapat na ilagay sa label ang sangkap at allergen.
related: FDA (License to Operate for food businesses)

items.title: Legal and taxes
steps: Register a business name with DTI (sole proprietor) online.
Register with BIR as self-employed/professional and get your receipts/invoices.
Ask BIR or an accountant whether the 8% income tax option fits you; it has conditions.
Keep simple books: income, expenses and receipts, monthly.
File and pay on time to avoid penalties.
steps_tl: Irehistro ang business name sa DTI (sole proprietor) online.
Magparehistro sa BIR bilang self-employed o professional at kumuha ng resibo o invoice.
Tanungin ang BIR o isang accountant kung bagay sa iyo ang 8% income tax option. May mga kundisyon ito.
Magtabi ng simpleng libro: kita, gastos, at resibo, buwan-buwan.
Mag-file at magbayad sa oras para maiwasan ang parusa.
items.tip: This is a general guide, not tax advice; confirm with BIR or a licensed accountant.
items.tip_tl: Pangkalahatang gabay ito, hindi tax advice. Kumpirmahin sa BIR o sa lisensyadong accountant.

items.title: Managing your income
steps: Separate personal and gig money (two wallets or accounts).
Make a monthly budget: needs, savings, wants.
Build an emergency fund before big purchases.
Keep contributing to SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG as a self-employed/voluntary member.
Consider Pag-IBIG MP2 savings; read the official terms first.
steps_tl: Ihiwalay ang personal na pera at ang pera ng gig (dalawang wallet o account).
Gumawa ng buwanang budget: pangangailangan, ipon, luho.
Bumuo ng emergency fund bago ang malaking bilihin.
Ipagpatuloy ang hulog sa SSS, PhilHealth, at Pag-IBIG bilang self-employed o voluntary member.
Isaalang-alang ang Pag-IBIG MP2. Basahin muna ang opisyal na tuntunin.
items.tip: Irregular income: save a portion of every payout.
items.tip_tl: Hindi regular ang kita: magtabi ng bahagi ng bawat payout.

note_tl: Simpleng gabay ang mga hakbang noong 2026-10-29. Walang ipinapangakong kita; nagbabago ang patakaran at bayad, kaya laging tingnan ang opisyal na site.
